top_signals.title: Fesharaki Says Oil’s Right Price Is $80-$90
top_signals.summary: FGE NexantECA Chairman Emeritus Fereidun Fesharaki thinks oil should trade at $80 to $90 a barrel based on supply and demand and low inventories. He expects oversupply to push prices toward $65 to $70 by this time next year. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Japan’s Government Bonds Extend Rally as BOJ Rate Hike Bets Fade
top_signals.summary: Japanese government bonds extended a sharp rally on Friday as a US stock selloff deepened a broader risk-off move and traders pared expectations for a Bank of Japan rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
top_signals.summary: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Fonterra's Allen Targets Value-Led Growth in China
top_signals.summary: Fonterra Co-operative Group CEO Richard Allen says Greater China, which accounts for about a third of its business, remains a strategic market. The dairy giant is focusing on higher-value products, innovation and localization as competition intensifies and China’s dairy industry evolves. He speaks with Minmin Low from the sidelines of 'China International Import Expo'. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: KB Financial Says Korea Stock Selloff Favors Buyers
top_signals.summary: KB Financial Group Global Strategist Peter S. Kim says South Korea’s equity correction is creating an opportunity for patient investors, with risk-reward now favoring buyers. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Niles: AI Trade Faces Repricing Amid Data Center Risks
top_signals.summary: Niles Investment Management Founder Dan Niles says the AI trade is entering a tougher phase as US data-center constraints, falling token prices and higher funding costs force investors to reassess valuations. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: The Army’s Command-and-Control Reboot
top_signals.summary:
How the Army makes decisions, communicates orders, coordinates forces, and keeps operations moving toward a common goal is undergoing a revolution. It’s called Next Generation Command and Control. Two of its architects — Lt. Gen. Matthew W. McFarlane, commanding general of I Corps, and Maj. Gen. Patrick J. Ellis, commanding general of the 4th Infantry Division — joined us to discuss this important set of organizational and technological innovations.Our thanks to AeroVironment for sponsoring the event at which this episode was recorded.Image: Kathryn Bailey via DVIDS
